URL: https://webapi3.adata.com/storage/downloadfile/datasheet_xpg_gammix_s50_core_pcie_gen4_x4_m2_ssd_20240417.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: XPG
Highlights:
www.xpg.com
XPG GAMMIX S50 CORE PCIe Gen4 x4 M.2 2280 Solid State Drive
The GAMMIX S50 CORE SSD features a PCIe Gen4 interface, reaches speeds of 3,500/2,800MB per second, 
supports the latest Intel and AMD platforms, and offers a generous 2000GB capacity. This SSD is a costeffective choice for all gamers.
